text:
incident-bot: ALERT: PagerDuty PD-8421 fired for service=autoscaler-runtime. symptom=queue_depth > 85% for 10m, fallback triggers pending. link=https://pagerduty.example/PD-8421 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: PD-8421 assigned to alex (on-call). Priority: P1. Escalation policy: autoscaler-oncall -> sre-lead. See incident details: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-8421

alex: I'm on it. Starting triage. Any recent deploys to autoscaler or embedding-prod?

tara: @alex we had a config roll 14m ago for autoscaler cooldown bump (30s -> 180s) to reduce churn. Traffic spiked after 4pm batch. Could be related.

liam: looking at metrics now — grafana: https://grafana.redwood/boards/embeddings-autoscaler
- queue_depth: 128k (baseline 10k)
- queue_growth_rate: +45% last 5m
- p95 latency (inference): 2.3s from 0.4s
- available_replicas: 6, desired_replicas: 18 (hpa not scaling up)

alex: confirmed HPA not reacting. pulling controller logs. Running: ```kubectl -n prod get hpa autoscaler-embeddings -o yaml```

alex: controller logs show repeated rejections on scale due to cooldown enforcement and throttle on cloud quota API. snippet: ```2025-08-02T16:12:01Z controller: skip scaling due to cooldown remaining=140s
2025-08-02T16:12:15Z controller: scale api rate limit exceeded, retry later
2025-08-02T16:13:05Z controller: desiredReplicas=18 current=6```

tara: so two factors: config cooldown + cloud API rate limits on instance provisioning. That explains why desired != available.

sre_lead: if we can temporarily bypass cooldown we should. Also consider manual scale to buy time. Ops_rotation, can you coordinate a manual scale and a quota request?

ops_rotation: I can do manual scale now. Will also open cloud support if quota is the blocker. Executing temporary manual scale to 30 replicas. Command: ```gcloud compute instance-groups managed set-size ig-autoscaler-prod --size=30 --zone=us-west1-b```

ops_rotation: DONE. API returned success. Instances launching (tracking instance creation).

liam: after manual scale - available_replicas jumped to 28 within 4m. queue_depth started to decline: 128k -> 42k -> 9k in 12m. p95 latency down to 0.6s.

pagerduty: PD-8421 acknowledged by alex at 2025-08-02T16:20:03Z.

alex: marking mitigation in notes: manual scale + request to rollback cooldown config. Next step: revert cooldown to 30s and add guardrails so HPA can call provisioning more smoothly.

tara: customer impact summary: observed 503s and enqueue failures between 16:08 and 16:20 UTC. Roughly 12 minutes of degraded responses. Affected surface: embeddings API; estimated 3.7% of total requests errored, hotspot customers: customer_acme and partner_bolt.

liam: logs for failures: ```ERROR inference: queue overflow, drop request id=abcd1234, customer=customer_acme
WARN http: upstream timeout 504 user=partner_bolt```

alex: notifying support/CS with impact summary and asking for outreach to top affected customers. tagging @support-channel.

ops_rotation: cloud support responded: quota throttle notice, but we requested expedited increase. They said provisioning delays due to global capacity in zone us-west1-b, ETA 30-45m for full new capacity if we don't have pre-allocated. Good we scaled manually into spare capacity.

sre_lead: immediate post-incident actions:
- revert cooldown config merge (PR #4521) -> rollback queued (tara/eng-prod)
- add backoff-aware HPA retry logic to avoid being blocked by API rate limits (liam/eng-runtime)
- add alert for hpa.desired != hpa.available for >2m (alex/eng-sre)
- run chaos/load test to validate cooldown changes under spike (oncall-runbook)

alex: creating a short postmortem stub and will fill in timeline + mitigation. Assigning owners as above.

tara: handoff to next on-call in 30m: @ops_rotation please monitor until quota increase is confirmed or rollback is live.

ops_rotation: will monitor. setting a reminder and creating follow-up PD incident if queue climbs.

liam: notes for blameless writeup: misaligned cooldown change + external quota constraints. action to add a canary/rollout gate for autoscaler config changes.

pagerduty: PD-8421 status: Resolved (manual scale + rollback planned). Closed at 2025-08-02T16:33:19Z by alex.

incident-bot: Reminder: please file a postmortem doc in #incidents within 72 hours and add the timeline, root cause, and remediation owners. Template: https://wiki.redwood/postmortems

alex: thanks team. tagging follow-ups in ticket: https://issues.redwood/INC-8421. I'll hand off ongoing monitoring to @ops_rotation in 20m.

sre_lead: nice work. No further action in channel unless queue rises.

ops_rotation: ack. Monitoring until 17:30 UTC.

(End of thread)
